question: For each customer and each month of 2020, first calculate the month-end balance by adding all deposit amounts and subtracting all withdrawal amounts that occurred during that specific month. Then determine which month in 2020 has the highest count of customers with a positive month-end balance and which month has the lowest count. For each of these two months, compute the average month-end balance across all customers and provide the difference between these two averages
sql:
WITH months AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT substr(txn_date, 1, 7) as month
    FROM customer_transactions
    WHERE substr(txn_date, 1, 4) = '2020'
),
all_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM customer_transactions WHERE substr(txn_date, 1, 4) = '2020'
),
customer_months AS (
    SELECT ac.customer_id, m.month
    FROM all_customers ac CROSS JOIN months m
),
monthly_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        cm.customer_id,
        cm.month,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ct.txn_type = 'deposit' THEN ct.txn_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) 
        - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ct.txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN ct.txn_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) as month_end_balance
    FROM customer_months cm
    LEFT JOIN customer_transactions ct 
        ON cm.customer_id = ct.customer_id 
        AND substr(ct.txn_date, 1, 7) = cm.month
    GROUP BY cm.customer_id, cm.month
),
month_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        month,
        AVG(month_end_balance) as avg_balance,
        SUM(CASE WHEN month_end_balance > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as positive_count
    FROM monthly_balances
    GROUP BY month
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        month,
        avg_balance,
        positive_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY positive_count DESC) as highest_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY positive_count ASC) as lowest_rank
    FROM month_stats
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(
        (SELECT avg_balance FROM ranked WHERE highest_rank = 1) - 
        (SELECT avg_balance FROM ranked WHERE lowest_rank = 1),
    4) as difference
